name: United Nova Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: United Nova Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and markets power discrete and modules in China and internationally. The company offers IGBTs, MOSFETs, and analog ICs, as well as MEMS and MCUs. It also provides system manufacturing solutions for automotive, clean energy technologies, industrials, and household appliances; solutions for automotive-grade IGBT/SiC chips and modules; and analog chips for mixed-signal high-voltage applications. The company was formerly known as Semiconductor Manufacturing Electronics (Shaoxing) Corporation and changed its name to United Nova Technology Co.,Ltd. in November 2023.
